components.description: B2B - Quantitative account-health gauge (0-100) with a SVG donut, verdict level (Excellent / Healthy / Watch / At risk / Critical) and the list of weighted signals used in the computation.
components.tagline: Quantitative account health score (0-100) with verdict level and weighted positive / negative signals.
components.seBenefit: Reads Cust360 SDO standard fields by default (e.g. churn risk, sentiment, NPS). On orgs without those fields, falls back to mocked signals — never crashes, always demo-ready.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'.

properties.name: revenueThreshold
properties.label: Revenue threshold
properties.description: AnnualRevenue below this counts as a negative signal.

properties.name: staleVisitThresholdDays
properties.label: Stale-visit threshold (days)
properties.description: Uses Account.SDO_MAPS_Days_Since_Last_Visit__c - skipped if the field is absent.

components.description: B2B - Narrative Account plan: KPIs, target progress, SWOT 2x2, action plan, strategic notes. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: Narrative account plan with editable KPIs, target gauge, SWOT 2x2 and quarterly action plan.
components.seBenefit: Inline editable from the page — no record write. Great visual for "strategic-account" demo moments, even on bare orgs.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls card title, section headings, SWOT labels, status pills (Not started / En cours…), buttons, toasts, and the default KPI labels / SWOT bullets / action plan / strategic notes.

properties.name: strengthsCsv
properties.label: Strengths - default bullets (override)
properties.description: Comma- or newline-separated. Leave empty for the language dictionary default.

properties.name: actionPlanCsv
properties.label: Action plan (override)
properties.description: Quarter|Action|Owner|Status, comma-separated. Status accepts English keys ('not started', 'in progress', 'on track', 'at risk', 'done') or French ('non commencé', 'en cours', 'dans les temps', 'à risque', 'terminé'). Leave empty for the language dictionary default.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Configurable list of Data Cloud / marketing segments, rendered as badges. The card title auto-appends the segment count.
components.tagline: Compact panel showing the marketing / Data Cloud segments the record belongs to, as colored badges.
keyProps: Up to 6 segment slots (label, audience size, last-updated)
components.seBenefit: Sets a marketing-aware tone on a Contact page without requiring a Data Cloud connection — props-driven storytelling.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls the default card title and default segment list. Explicit values on cardTitle / segmentsCsv still override the dictionary.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default (‘Active Segments’ / ‘Segments actifs’). Shown as '<title> (N)'.

properties.name: segmentsCsv
properties.label: Segments (comma-separated) (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language-appropriate default list. Each item becomes a badge.

properties.name: colorMode
properties.label: Color mode
properties.description: 'random' (default) = each tag gets a soft pastel from a curated palette. 'custom' = use the customColorsCsv list. 'single' = every tag uses the singleColor value.

properties.name: customColorsCsv
properties.label: Custom colors (hex CSV, for 'custom' mode)
properties.description: Comma-separated hex colors, one per segment. Shorter lists cycle. Ignored unless colorMode = custom.

properties.name: singleColor
properties.label: Single color (hex, for 'single' mode)
properties.description: Applied to every tag when colorMode = single. Defaults to the SLDS-style light grey.

components.description: Aggregated activity timeline showing Tasks, Events, Emails, SMS/Web, calls, messaging sessions, chats, Orders, Cases, Opportunities, Quotes, Contracts, Visits, Files, Chatter posts and Survey responses for an Account or Contact.
components.tagline: Unified activity timeline aggregating 16+ Salesforce record types in a single feed with rich filtering.
components.seBenefit: Pulls from `Task`, `Event`, `EmailMessage`, `VoiceCall`, `MessagingSession`, `LiveChatTranscript`, `Order`, `Case`, `Opportunity`, `Quote`, `Contract`, `Visit`, `ContentDocumentLink`, `FeedItem`, `SurveyResponse` — and uses business-meaningful dates (CloseDate, EffectiveDate, StartDate) instead of CreatedDate.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls card title, filter panel, type/date labels, empty state, action buttons and group headings. Uses Intl for date formatting.

properties.name: excludeRelatedContacts
properties.label: Exclude related-contact activities
properties.description: Default: unchecked (related contacts included). Check to scope strictly to the current record.

properties.name: sortOldestFirst
properties.label: Sort oldest first
properties.description: Default: unchecked (newest first).

properties.name: enabledActionsCsv
properties.label: Quick actions (CSV of API names)
properties.description: Standard quick-action API names triggered from the toolbar. Adjust to match actions available on the object's page layout.

properties.name: initialLimit
properties.label: Initial items to display
properties.description: Max total items shown (upcoming + past combined) before the 'Show more' button appears.

properties.name: defaultEnabledTypesCsv
properties.label: Default enabled activity types (CSV of keys)
properties.description: Comma-separated list of type keys enabled by default. Empty = all. Keys: Task, Event, Email, EmailMessage, ListEmail, Call, VoiceCall, MessagingSession, LiveChatTranscript, Cadence, Order, Case, Opportunity, Quote, Contract, Visit, File, FeedItem, SurveyResponse.

components.description: Home page greeting banner with Astro mascot, a voice-dictation field and a send button. {name} is replaced with the running user's first name. Bilingual FR / EN.
components.tagline: Astro-themed Home page header with a search / dictation box that forwards questions to the Agentforce panel.
components.seBenefit: Speech-to-text via the browser API — speak a question, click "Send", and the transcribed text lands in your clipboard. Paste it into the standard Agentforce panel for a fluid AI demo entry. (No real Agentforce integration — the UI fakes the gesture.)

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls the default greeting, placeholders and speech locale.

properties.name: greetingTemplate
properties.label: Greeting text (override)
properties.description: Use {name} to inject the running user's first name. Wrap any word with double asterisks for the highlighted colour, e.g. 'Bonjour **{name}**, comment puis-je vous aider ?'. Leave empty to use the language default.

properties.name: highlightColor
properties.label: Highlight color (hex)
properties.description: Applied to the **bold** segment of the greeting. Defaults to the CCO FR brand blue.

properties.name: idlePlaceholder
properties.label: Input placeholder - idle (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the language default ('Posez-moi une question…' / 'Ask me a question…').

properties.name: speechLocale
properties.label: Speech recognition locale (override)
properties.description: BCP 47 tag (e.g. fr-FR, en-US). Leave empty to use the language default.

components.description: Configurable alerts ribbon. Two sources: rule-driven alerts evaluated against the current record (Record Page), and static alerts always shown (Home / App Page friendly). 4 severities, 3 visual variants, 2 densities, optional sticky-on-scroll behavior.
components.tagline: Configurable alerts ribbon combining declarative record-driven rules with always-on static banners.
components.seBenefit: Rule-driven mode evaluates a tiny DSL against the current record's fields ("AnnualRevenue<500000|warning|...") — drop on any record page, the right alert pops on the right account, no code.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: rulesCsv
properties.label: Rule-driven alerts (one per line)
properties.description: Format: '<field><op><value>|<severity>|<icon>|<message>|<ctaLabel>|<ctaUrl>'. Operators: = | != | > | < | >= | <= | contains | startsWith | endsWith | isBlank | isNotBlank. Severity: info | success | warning | error. Icon and CTA fields are optional.

properties.name: staticAlertsCsv
properties.label: Static alerts (one per line)
properties.description: Always shown. Format: '<severity>|<icon>|<message>|<ctaLabel>|<ctaUrl>'.

properties.name: visualStyle
properties.label: Visual style
properties.description: 'inline' (default) renders alerts directly above the page content. 'card' wraps them in a lightning-card chrome with a title and a count pill.

properties.name: alertVariant
properties.label: Alert variant
properties.description: 'banner' (soft pastel + accent border-left), 'solid' (saturated background), 'minimal' (white background, accent bar only).

properties.name: density
properties.label: Layout density
properties.description: 'comfortable' allows wrap. 'compact' truncates the message with ellipsis.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Used only when visualStyle = card. Leave empty for the dictionary default.

properties.name: cardIcon
properties.label: Card icon
properties.description: SLDS icon name. Used only when visualStyle = card.

properties.name: stickyOnScroll
properties.label: Sticky on scroll
properties.description: When ON, the ribbon stays pinned to the top of the page on scroll.

components.description: B2B / B2C - GDPR / contact-preferences toggle panel. Reads/writes opt-in/opt-out fields on the record. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: Per-channel GDPR consent toggle panel binding each channel to a boolean field on the current record.
components.seBenefit: Default channels map onto Salesforce standard fields: `HasOptedOutOfEmail`, `DoNotCall`, `HasOptedOutOfFax` (used as a stand-in for WhatsApp opt-out). Drop on Contact / Lead / Account → it just works, no custom field required.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' or 'fr'. Controls card title, toggle labels, toast messages, and default channel labels (E-mail / Téléphone / WhatsApp).

properties.name: channelsCsv
properties.label: Channels CSV (override)
properties.description: One channel per item. Format: label|fieldApiName|inverted. Inverted=true when the field stores opt-OUT. Leave empty for the language dictionary default (maps Email / Phone / WhatsApp onto Contact standard opt-out fields).

components.description: B2B / B2C - Visual Contact card (avatar, details, up to 3 gauges) with animated waves + optional Einstein prompt summary. Original author: Charly Ansel.
components.tagline: Visual contact card with animated waves, avatar, address, configurable gauges and optional Einstein prompt summary.
keyProps: Up to 3 gauges (label, field, icon, lower/higher-better semantics)
Image · URL field OR click-to-upload File
Einstein prompt summary · default `einstein_gpt__summarizeContact` (the SDO-shipped template, not a true Salesforce standard)
components.seBenefit: Built-in "Summarize" button using the SDO-shipped contact-summary prompt — drop on a Contact / Case / Account page and you get an AI inline summary out of the box. Click the avatar to upload a contact photo (no schema work required).

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls every visible label.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Contact').

properties.name: hideHeaderOnContact
properties.label: Hide card header on Contact page
properties.description: Off by default. Turn ON to remove the card title + icon when the component is placed on a Contact record page (the page already tells the user it is a contact).

properties.name: imageFieldApiName
properties.label: Image URL field API name (optional)
properties.description: Schema-safe: skipped if absent. When the contact has a value in this URL field, it wins over any uploaded file. Leave empty to rely solely on the click-to-upload File storage.

properties.name: disableImageReplace
properties.label: Disable click-to-replace image
properties.description: Off by default - clicking the avatar opens a file picker and uploads the new image as a File on the linked Contact (works on Contact, Case, Account etc. record pages). Turn ON to lock the avatar.

properties.name: customerIdFieldApiName
properties.label: Customer ID field API name
properties.description: Schema-safe: the line is skipped if the field is absent or empty.

properties.name: gauge1Label
properties.label: Gauge 1 - label
properties.description: Leave empty to hide the first gauge.

properties.name: gauge1FieldApiName
properties.label: Gauge 1 - field API name (optional)
properties.description: Numeric Contact field (0-100). When set and the record has a numeric value, it wins over the static value below. Schema-safe: skipped if absent.

properties.name: gauge1Value
properties.label: Gauge 1 - static value (optional)
properties.description: Type a number directly (0-100) to display it without needing a field. Useful for demos. Used as a fallback when the field above is empty.

properties.name: gauge1Direction
properties.label: Gauge 1 - semantics
properties.description: 'lower-better' (0=green, 100=red) for risk-style metrics. 'higher-better' (0=red, 100=green) for health / satisfaction.

properties.name: hideWaves
properties.label: Hide animated waves
properties.description: Off by default - the card shows soft animated wave shapes tinted with the active Lightning theme accent. Turn ON to hide them.

properties.name: showWaves
properties.label: (deprecated) Show animated waves
properties.description: No longer used. Use 'Hide animated waves' above.

properties.name: isDarkBackground
properties.label: Dark background
properties.description: Switches text color to white. Use in tandem with a dark background color / image.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.label: Background color (CSS)
properties.description: Optional. Example: '#fff', 'rgb(30,30,60)'.

properties.name: backgroundImageUrl
properties.label: Background image URL
properties.description: Optional. Add the external domain to Trusted Sites if needed.

properties.name: waveColorOne
properties.label: Wave 1 color (override)
properties.description: Optional CSS color. Leave empty to use a tinted version of the Lightning theme accent.

properties.name: waveColorTwo
properties.label: Wave 2 color (override)
properties.description: Optional CSS color. Leave empty to use a lighter tint of the theme accent.

properties.name: disablePromptSummary
properties.label: Disable prompt summary (Einstein)
properties.description: Off by default - the 'Résumer / Summarize' button is displayed and uses the prompt template below. Turn ON to hide the button entirely.

properties.name: enablePromptSummary
properties.label: (deprecated)
properties.description: Use 'Disable prompt summary' above. This property is kept for backwards compatibility only.

properties.name: promptButtonLabel
properties.label: Prompt button label (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Résumer' / 'Summarize').

properties.name: promptTemplateApiName
properties.label: Prompt template API name
properties.description: Developer name of the Einstein Prompt Template to run. Defaults to the SDO-standard contact summary template ('einstein_gpt__summarizeContact').

properties.name: promptInputApiName
properties.label: Prompt template input API name
properties.description: Typically 'Input:Contact'.

properties.name: autoPromptOnLoad
properties.label: Run prompt automatically on load
properties.description: When on and the prompt is enabled, the summary fires as soon as the component loads - no button click required.

components.description: B2B - Visual carousel of the Contacts linked to an Account. Photo (or initials fallback), title, optional role badge and quick Email/Call actions. Arrows to navigate when there are more than the visible count.
components.tagline: Horizontal carousel of an Account's Contacts with avatars, role badges and quick Email / Call actions.
components.seBenefit: Visual replacement for the standard Contacts related list — much more demo-friendly than a flat table.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'.

properties.name: limitCount
properties.label: Max contacts fetched
properties.description: Server-side LIMIT (1-100).

properties.name: orderBy
properties.label: Sort
properties.description: Whitelisted: LastActivityDate DESC NULLS LAST | Name ASC | CreatedDate DESC | Title ASC NULLS LAST.

properties.name: visibleCount
properties.label: Cards visible at once
properties.description: Number of cards shown per page in the carousel. Arrows paginate by this amount.

properties.name: badgesCsv
properties.label: Role badges (name=label|color, CSV)
properties.description: Per-contact badge overlay. Format: 'Eliott Mercier=Champion|#2e844a,Mathieu Bernard=Detractor|#ba0517'. Match is case-insensitive on Contact.Name.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Lists the orders linked to an Account or Contact. Top block shows the latest order with its line items; bottom block is a compact history with search / sort / status filter / View all. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: Last order detail card plus searchable, sortable, filterable order history for an Account or Contact.
components.seBenefit: Renders product images per line — turns a plain list into a visual catalog reminiscent of an e-commerce order history. Compatible with SDO product image fields out of the box.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls every built-in string (headers, buttons, sort labels, empty states).

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Orders' / 'Commandes').

properties.name: historyLimit
properties.label: Max orders in history
properties.description: Server-side LIMIT (1-50).

properties.name: statusFilter
properties.label: Status whitelist (CSV, optional)
properties.description: Comma-separated list of Order.Status values. When set, only orders matching these statuses are shown, and a status picker appears above the history list. Leave empty to allow every status.

properties.name: defaultSort
properties.label: Default sort
properties.description: One of: EffectiveDate DESC | EffectiveDate ASC | TotalAmount DESC | TotalAmount ASC | OrderNumber ASC | OrderNumber DESC.

properties.name: productImageFieldApiName
properties.label: Product image field API name
properties.description: Field on Product2 holding the image URL. Schema-safe - skipped if absent.

properties.name: productImageFallbackUrl
properties.label: Product image fallback URL
properties.description: Used when the product image field is empty or absent.

components.description: B2C - Customer-level sales summary for a Contact / Person Account / Account record page. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: B2C-leaning sales summary with KPI tiles and breakdowns by Category, Brand and Store.
components.seBenefit: Same component covers B2B and B2C scenarios — auto-detects Person Account vs. business Account and adapts the layout.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' or 'fr'. Controls the default card title, KPI labels, column titles, the stores suffix and the default CSV content for categories / brands / stores.

properties.name: kpi1Value
properties.label: KPI 1 - Value (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('38 550 €' / '$38,550').

properties.name: kpi2Value
properties.label: KPI 2 - Value (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('285 €' / '$285').

properties.name: kpi3Value
properties.label: KPI 3 - Value (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('18').

components.description: Marketing and Data - Configurable marketing engagement timeline (Email, SMS, Form, Page View) with live search and typed colored icons. Mock data mode - no Apex, no SOQL. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: Configurable marketing engagement timeline with colored typed icons and inline search.
components.seBenefit: Demonstrates a Marketing Cloud-style engagement history without needing MCAE installed. Perfect for demos on scratch orgs or SDOs without Marketing Cloud connectivity.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title, search placeholder, event type labels and empty state text.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language dictionary default.

properties.name: eventTypes
properties.label: Event types (pipe-separated)
properties.default: Email ouvert|SMS envoye|Formulaire|Email clique|Page vue|Email rejete|Email envoye|SMS clique
properties.description: FR: Email ouvert, Email envoye, Email clique, Email rejete, SMS envoye, SMS clique, Formulaire, Page vue. EN: Email Open, Email Sent, Email Click, Email Bounce, SMS Sent, SMS Click, Form Submit, Page View.

properties.name: eventLists
properties.label: Lists / campaigns (pipe-separated)
properties.default: Campagne Ete 2026|SMS Relance Auto|Webinaire Produit Q2|Nurturing Web|Acquisition SEO|Offre Flash Juin|Campagne Rentree|Promo Weekend

properties.name: eventAges
properties.label: Relative ages (pipe-separated)
properties.default: 2 j.|4 j.|1 sem.|1 sem. 3 j.|2 sem.|3 sem.|1 mois|1 mois 5 j.

components.masterLabel: CCO FR - Field Sales - Rep Home
components.description: B2B - Home / App page for a field sales rep. Greeting, 4 KPI tiles, priority accounts (dynamic, filter-configurable), hot leads, product-penetration bars and campaign calendar. Bilingual EN / FR via the language property.
components.tagline: Field Sales rep home page with greeting, KPIs, priority accounts, hot leads, product penetration and campaign calendar.
components.seBenefit: One Home page with all the field-sales context preloaded — no need to assemble 5 components on a custom App Page.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Every label below without an explicit value falls back to the language dictionary. Setting any label explicitly overrides the dictionary for that one string.

properties.name: greetingTemplate
properties.label: Greeting template (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default. Use {name} placeholder. Wrap any word with **…** to render it in the highlight color.

properties.name: defaultUserName
properties.label: Fallback user name (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for dictionary default ('Rep' / 'Commercial').

properties.name: highlightColor
properties.label: Greeting highlight color (hex)
properties.description: Applied to **bold** segments of the greeting. Defaults to the CCO FR brand blue.

properties.name: accountRecordType
properties.label: Accounts - RecordType.DeveloperName filter
properties.description: Leave empty for all record types. SDO default: 'SDO_Account_Simple' (B2B).

properties.name: accountOwnerScope
properties.label: Accounts - owner scope
properties.description: 'mine' | 'all'

properties.name: accountOrderBy
properties.label: Accounts - sort
properties.description: Name | LastActivityDate DESC NULLS LAST | AnnualRevenue DESC NULLS LAST | CreatedDate DESC

properties.name: leadRating
properties.label: Leads - rating filter
properties.description: 'Hot' | 'Warm' | 'Cool' | 'Any'

properties.name: leadOwnerScope
properties.label: Leads - owner scope
properties.description: 'mine' | 'all'

properties.name: visitMotivesCsv
properties.label: Visit motives (text|cssClass, CSV) (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for language dictionary default.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Visual gallery of files linked to the current record. Image thumbnails via the rendition endpoint, doctype icons for other types, click to open preview, Download link and drag-drop upload.
components.tagline: Visual gallery of files attached to any record with image thumbnails, doctype icons and drag-and-drop upload.
keyProps: Max files, visible count in carousel
components.seBenefit: Real image thumbnails (not just generic doctype icons) — pull product photos, brand assets, contracts. Drag-drop upload zone is custom-built (not the native `lightning-file-upload`) so the layout looks clean in narrow sidebar columns.

properties.name: limitCount
properties.label: Max files
properties.description: Server-side LIMIT (1-100).

properties.name: visibleCount
properties.label: Files visible in the carousel
properties.description: Number of tiles shown on one row. Chevrons in the header page through the rest.

properties.name: hideDeleteButton
properties.label: Hide delete button on tiles
properties.description: Off by default - each tile shows a delete icon on hover. The user must have delete permission on the file.

components.description: Generic kanban board. Any SObject + group-by picklist + display field. Optional drag & drop that updates the group-by field on the record. Whitelisted objects: Case, Opportunity, Lead, Order, Task, Account.
components.tagline: Generic kanban board with native drag & drop on any whitelisted SObject (Case, Opp, Lead, Order, Task, Account).
components.seBenefit: Same component supports 6 SObjects — drop on a Home Page (all my open cases), an App Page (team kanban), or a Record Page (Account-scoped cases). Drag-drop instantly updates the status field.

properties.name: sobjectApiName
properties.label: SObject to query
properties.description: Whitelisted: Case | Opportunity | Lead | Order | Task | Account. On a Record Page this drives which object's records are listed (it does NOT follow the host page's object).

properties.name: objectApiName
properties.label: (deprecated) Object API name
properties.description: Legacy alias - use 'SObject to query' above. Kept to avoid breaking existing FlexiPages.

properties.name: groupByField
properties.label: Group-by field API name
properties.description: Picklist field used to form the columns.

properties.name: displayField
properties.label: Display field API name
properties.description: Field shown as the card title.

properties.name: amountField
properties.label: Amount field (optional)
properties.description: Currency / decimal field summed per column, e.g. 'Amount' on Opportunity.

properties.name: filterClause
properties.label: SOQL WHERE clause (optional)
properties.description: Raw SOQL fragment. Leave empty for no filter. Be cautious - injected as-is.

properties.name: limitCount
properties.label: Max records
properties.description: Server-side LIMIT (1-500).

properties.name: maxPerColumn
properties.label: Max cards visible per column
properties.description: Beyond this cap, a 'Show all (N)' link unfolds the column.

properties.name: disableDragDrop
properties.label: Disable drag & drop
properties.description: Off by default - cards are draggable between columns; dropping updates the group-by field.

properties.name: recordScopeField
properties.label: Record-scope field API name
properties.description: Lookup field on the queried object pointing at the current Record Id. Examples: 'AccountId' for Case / Opportunity / Order on an Account page. Leave empty to disable scoping.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Configurable grid of 3 to 6 clickable KPI tiles. Pick a preset (Standard / Field Sales / Telesales / Custom) or override any tile individually. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: Configurable grid of 3-6 clickable KPI tiles with icon, value, color and link, ready out of the box.
keyProps: Up to 8 tiles (label, value, trend %, target URL)
components.seBenefit: Most-tunable component in the library (40+ properties). Click-through targets let you stage navigation flows during a demo without writing a Flow or App Builder action.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: preset
properties.label: KPI preset
properties.description: Seeds tiles 1-3 with a pre-configured set. Standard = Leads / Opportunities / Accounts. FieldSales = Route / Prospecting / Goals. Telesales = Calls / Open Cases / Orders. Custom = no seed - fill every tile manually below.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the default (‘Cockpit’). The grid is wrapped in a lightning-card when a title is set.

properties.name: kpi1Label
properties.label: KPI 1 - Label (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the preset value.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Single KPI tile with inline trend chart. 4 chart styles (line, area, bar, mini-donut), optional comparison series, target line, currency formatting. Bilingual FR / EN.
components.tagline: Single-metric tile with 4 chart styles (line / area / bar / mini-donut), comparison series, target line and currency formatting.
components.seBenefit: Compact tile, dashboard-ready — set `hideCardTitle = true` to stack 4 tiles in a row aligned. Mini-donut variant is the striking "85% to target" demo moment without configuring a real Performance Goal.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Indicateur' / 'Metric').

properties.name: hideCardTitle
properties.label: Hide the card wrapper
properties.description: Off by default - the tile is wrapped in a lightning-card with a title. Turn on to render the bare tile (no card header) for dense dashboards.

properties.name: metricLabel
properties.label: Metric label (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('CA (12 mois)' / 'Revenue (12 mo.)').

properties.name: currentValueDisplay
properties.label: Headline value (text override)
properties.description: Large value shown at the top of the tile. Wins over the numeric currentValue when set. Leave empty for the language default.

properties.name: currentValue
properties.label: Headline value (numeric, optional)
properties.description: Numeric value used to auto-format the headline via Intl.NumberFormat (compact currency). Ignored when 'Headline value (text override)' is set.

properties.name: currencyCode
properties.label: Currency ISO code
properties.description: Used by the numeric formatter. ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP...).

properties.name: chartStyle
properties.label: Chart style
properties.description: 'line' (curve only), 'area' (curve + filled area below), 'bar' (vertical bars), 'mini-donut' (radial gauge from currentValue / targetValue).

properties.name: seriesJson
properties.label: Series points - JSON array
properties.description: Array of numbers. 12 points = one per month. Leave empty for a sample up-trend curve. Ignored by 'mini-donut' style.

properties.name: secondarySeriesJson
properties.label: Secondary series - JSON array (optional)
properties.description: Optional comparison series (e.g. forecast, target run-rate). Drawn as a dashed line. Ignored by 'mini-donut' style.

properties.name: targetValue
properties.label: Target value (optional)
properties.description: When set, draws a horizontal dashed line at this Y on line/area/bar charts. Used as the denominator for the mini-donut variant.

properties.name: showTargetLabel
properties.label: Show target label chip
properties.description: Off by default. Turn ON to display a 'Target XX €' chip next to the metric label.

properties.name: scalingMode
properties.label: Y-axis scaling
properties.description: 'auto' (data min/max), 'from-zero' (forces Y origin to 0), 'fixed' (uses yMin / yMax below).

properties.name: accentColor
properties.label: Accent color (hex)
properties.description: Color of the primary chart series. Defaults to CCO FR brand blue.

properties.name: donutTrack
properties.label: Mini-donut track color (hex)
properties.description: Background ring color. Used only when chartStyle = mini-donut.

properties.name: height
properties.label: Chart height (px)
properties.description: Internal viewBox height. CSS scales the SVG to fit the column width.

properties.name: width
properties.label: Chart width override (px)
properties.description: 0 = auto (default ~600px viewBox). Set a fixed value for very narrow tiles.

properties.name: trendDisplay
properties.label: Trend badge text
properties.description: Sign drives the color: a leading '+' (or no sign on a non-zero number) is green, '-' is red, '0%' is grey.

properties.name: enableTooltip
properties.label: Enable hover tooltip
properties.description: Off by default. Turn ON to show value-on-point on hover (line / area / bar).

properties.name: trendPositive
properties.label: (deprecated) Trend is positive
properties.description: No longer used - the color is auto-derived from the sign of trendDisplay.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Today-timeline view of events for a sidebar column. Auto-trims empty hours, handles overlapping events side-by-side, live now-line, in-N-min badge, Join button for common web-meeting URLs, and a short Upcoming list.
components.tagline: Today's calendar as a compact vertical timeline that fits a sidebar column, with Google-Calendar-style overlap.
components.seBenefit: Useful in both Field Sales (today's appointments) and as a transversal "agenda" widget on any persona's Home Page.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: Two-letter code - 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls all built-in UI strings (headings, buttons, badges). Explicit values set on cardTitle / emptyStateMessage still override the dictionary.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default (‘My Day’ / ‘Ma journée’).

properties.name: startHour
properties.label: Start hour (0-23)
properties.description: Earliest hour shown when auto-trim is off or when auto-trim can't narrow further.

properties.name: endHour
properties.label: End hour (0-23)
properties.description: Latest hour shown (same rule as start hour).

properties.name: disableAutoTrim
properties.label: Disable auto-trim
properties.description: Auto-trim is ON by default - the timeline is bounded to [first event − padding, last event + padding] (clamped between Start and End hour). Turn this on to always render the full Start→End hour window.

properties.name: autoTrimPaddingMin
properties.label: Auto-trim padding (minutes)
properties.description: Empty-hour margin kept before the first event and after the last event when auto-trim is on. Set to 0 to crop exactly to the events.

properties.name: daysAhead
properties.label: Days ahead to query
properties.description: Today counts as 1. Used to populate the Upcoming list.

properties.name: typeColorsCsv
properties.label: Type colors (Type|#hex, comma-separated)
properties.description: Matched against Event.Type (case-insensitive). 'Other' is the fallback.

properties.name: typesFilterCsv
properties.label: Event types to keep (comma-separated, optional)
properties.description: Whitelist of Event.Type values to show. Leave empty to include every type. Acts as a static filter - the in-UI toggles mute types on top of this.

properties.name: hideTypeToggles
properties.label: Hide clickable type toggles
properties.description: Off by default - chips are shown. Turn on to hide the one-chip-per-Event.Type filter strip that lets the user mute/unmute each 'calendar' in the timeline.

properties.name: hideNowLine
properties.label: Hide the 'now' line
properties.description: Off by default - the red line is shown.

properties.name: hideJoinButton
properties.label: Hide the auto-detected Join button
properties.description: Off by default - scans Event Location and Description for a Zoom / Teams / Meet / WebEx URL and shows a Join button when found.

properties.name: emptyStateMessage
properties.label: Empty-state message (override)
properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Compact "My Tasks" panel for a sidebar column. Interactive completion checkbox, filter dropdown, auto-grouping by Overdue / Today / Tomorrow / This week / Later, optional quick actions, and "New task" shortcut.

properties.name: filterOptionsCsv

properties.name: emptyStateMessage

properties.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default.

properties.name: recordTypeName

properties.name: erpCheckboxLabel

components.description: Configurable AI panel that runs Salesforce Prompt Templates via Invocable Actions. Drop on any page, the SE picks which prompts to expose. Auto-fills record context, prompts requiring user input show a small form. HTML responses rendered with formatting.

Auto record-type filtering (Account → Account summary, Home → free-text prompts)
Auto-detect HTML / Markdown response · dynamic height

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)

properties.name: namedCredential
properties.label: Named Credential
properties.description: Named Credential routing the Apex callout to the org's REST API. Default 'Agentforce_API'. Despite the legacy name, it's used for any /services/data/... callout — Prompt Templates, Agent API, etc. Setup → Named Credentials in your org.

properties.name: promptsJson
properties.label: Prompts catalogue (JSON)
properties.description: JSON array. Each entry: { apiName, label, icon, objects:['Account',...], recordInputName:'Input:Account', userInputs:[{name,label,type,required,options}] }. 'objects' filters by host record type — empty list = always show. Leave the prop empty to use the default catalogue (Account/Contact/Deal/Lead/Case summaries + free-text Summarize/Refine).

properties.name: autoRunFirstPrompt
properties.label: Auto-run first prompt on load
properties.description: When ON, the first applicable prompt runs automatically as soon as the page loads. Skips silently if any required user input is empty.

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.label: Maximum component height (px)
properties.description: 0 (default) = no cap, the component grows with the AI response. Set a number (e.g. 600) to cap the vertical footprint and enable scroll inside the component when the response is very long.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Custom highlights panel with round image and configurable fields/actions. Works on Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Lead, Order, Contract, Quote - can display the current record or its parent Account (recordSource property).

properties.name: accountFieldsList

properties.name: contactFieldsList

properties.name: imageFieldApiName

Leave empty to rely on the built-in File storage - the component uploads the replacement as a standard File on the record, no custom schema required.

components.description: Sales / Field Sales - Map view of the territory: Accounts pinned by billing geo, color-coded by open pipeline, with side filters (Owner, RecordType, Open amount range, Stages, Case status, Type, Industry + name search), KPI tiles and CSV export.
components.tagline: Interactive territory map with geocoded Accounts, pipeline color coding, sidebar filters and CSV export.
keyProps: Owner / RecordType / amount range / stages / case status
2 configurable picklist filters (Type, Industry by default)
Map height, map / list ratio, default center (France)
components.seBenefit: Pins are color-coded by open-pipeline tier (red top 20% / orange / green / grey) — instantly visualizes territory health. CSV export lets you pull the filtered list for follow-up reports.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default.

properties.name: limitCount
properties.label: Max accounts
properties.description: Server-side LIMIT (1-200).

properties.name: defaultOwnerScope
properties.label: Default owner scope
properties.description: 'mine' = accounts owned by the running user (with auto-fallback to all when empty). 'all' = every owner.

properties.name: defaultRecordType
properties.label: Default RecordType (developer name)
properties.description: Optional. Pre-selects an Account RecordType filter (developer name). Leave empty to show all types.

properties.name: defaultStagesCsv
properties.label: Default opportunity stages (CSV)
properties.description: Optional. Pre-selects opportunity stages used to compute open-amount KPIs. Empty = all open opportunities.

properties.name: filterFieldAApiName
properties.label: Filter field A (API name)
properties.description: API name of an Account picklist used as a filter and shown in the side list (default: Type). Set to a custom field if useful.

properties.name: filterFieldBApiName
properties.label: Filter field B (API name)
properties.description: API name of an Account picklist used as a filter and shown in the side list (default: Industry). Set to a custom field if useful.

properties.name: currencyCode
properties.label: Currency ISO code
properties.description: ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP...).

properties.name: zoomLevel
properties.label: Default zoom level
properties.description: lightning-map zoom level (1=world, 13=neighborhood).

properties.name: defaultCenterLatitude
properties.label: Default center - latitude
properties.description: Initial map center latitude. Defaults to France (46.7). Override for other regions.

properties.name: defaultCenterLongitude
properties.label: Default center - longitude
properties.description: Initial map center longitude. Defaults to France (2.5).

properties.name: mapHeight
properties.label: Map height (px)
properties.description: Fixed height of the map + list area. The list scrolls independently inside this height.

properties.name: mapWidthRatio
properties.label: Map / list ratio
properties.description: Horizontal split ratio between the map (left) and the account list (right). Range 0.4 - 0.85. Default 0.66 = map ~ 2/3, list ~ 1/3.

components.description: B2B / B2C - Horizontal multi-phase timeline (e.g. customer journey / project steps). Phases are JSON-configured with labels, target dates and done flags. A vertical "Today" marker shows current position.
components.tagline: Horizontal multi-phase timeline with date axis, 'Today' marker and done / pending state per phase.
components.seBenefit: Visualizes a journey or process state without needing custom objects or flows — type the phases directly in App Builder.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title and the default phases when Phases JSON is empty.

properties.name: scope
properties.label: Default phases scope
properties.description: Seeds the default phases depending on where the component is used. 'record' = customer / deal cycle (Prospection → Découverte → Démo → Proposition → Closing). 'home' = global fiscal milestones (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 kick-off / ramp-up / expansion / year-end). Override with Phases JSON below to customise fully.

properties.name: cardTitle
properties.label: Card title (override)
properties.description: Leave empty for the language default ('Parcours' / 'Journey').

properties.name: phasesJson
properties.label: Phases - JSON array (override)
properties.description: Array of objects. Each item: { label, date (YYYY-MM-DD), done (boolean) }. Leave empty for the scope + language default.

properties.name: hideTodayMarker
properties.label: Hide 'Today' marker
properties.description: Off by default - the vertical dotted line showing today's position is displayed.

components.description: Dictate a voice note and save it as a completed Task linked to the current record. Bilingual EN / FR.
components.tagline: Dictate a voice note via the Web Speech API and save it as a completed Task linked to the current record.
components.seBenefit: Speech-to-text via the browser `SpeechRecognition` API — no Einstein / external service dependency. Demoable on any org as long as Chrome is the browser.

properties.name: language
properties.label: UI language
properties.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls every visible string. Explicit values override per-field.

properties.name: speechLocale
properties.label: Speech recognition locale
properties.description: BCP 47 tag (e.g. en-US, fr-FR). Independent of the UI language - set it to the language the user will actually speak.
